name: C'Thun
notes: Numbers follow docs/research/temple-of-ahnqiraj/cthun.md. HP is a clock over 425 s, with Eye HP and C'Thun HP sharing one bar (real pools 4,996,500 and 6,328,900, both 'Seasonal 40 Player'): Phase 1 is 180 s (real kills are 3 to 5 min) and Phase 2 is two carapace cycles (first surface 60 s, stomach 25 s, Weakened 45 s, second surface 45 s, stomach 25 s, Weakened 45 s; a typical raid needs 2 or 3 Weakened). ESTIMATES: the room is a 50 yd circle, spawn spots and the tentacle ring are placed from prose. The 10,000 HP tank model does not really apply: C'Thun has no melee and no tank in Phase 1, so the ghost tank's health is a stand-in for the raid's healing demand: `eyeBeamRaid` (1,500 every 3 s on the ghost) is scaled so passive healing (`healPerSecond` 600) holds it and a player healer doing nothing loses it inside 30 s (150 per second). Eye Beam is a `carried` `hazard` with `stayPut` (`radius` 9.5, `placement: random`, 2 s warning, every 3 s from 9 s in, so the ghost raid has finished walking to its formation) that lands on a random raider, a third of the time you (`playerChance` 0.33). The raid holds a real hexagonal formation (`raidSpot.spacing` 10) and raiders step aside for the player, so the right play is to pre-spread and stand still, as every guide says; `chainedBeams` counts each detonation with another raider inside. Radius 9.5 rather than the real 10 so a raider exactly on the next lattice cell is not counted. `raid.melee` is 1 so nobody stands on the formation's centre cell, which is under the Eye; the real melee ring is the rest of the lattice. Real chain range is 10 yd and the real Eye Beam doubles or multiplies by 1.5 per jump; the engine has no chain, so the penalty is the metric. Beams stop for Dark Glare via `conditional: debuff:beamWindow`, a debuff whose window is the gap between sweeps. Dark Glare: the research-accurate timer (first at 48 s, every 86 s, 40 s long) on nine `lane` hazards stepping 20 degrees every 4.4 s, the first sweep from south around the east side and the second mirrored around the west, starting 10 yd out at the Eye's edge (the wiki says clockwise or counterclockwise; the real start direction follows the Eye's target, which the engine cannot express; Dark Glare's beam width, spell 26029, could not be verified, so the 12 yd lanes are unconfirmed) (`placement: lanes`, 12 yd wide, 2 s telegraph, 2.4 s active so one lane burns at a time, lethal 12,000, standing in for the real 43,750 to 56,250). ENGINE GAP: a real rotating `cone` cannot be built because the `cone` kind resolves instantly around the boss's current heading and the marker cannot dodge it, and a heading that sweeps on a timer has no field. Stepped lanes give the same footwork and scoring (`deepBreath`, `outsideLane`) but a `lane` is a rectangle, not a wedge. Tentacles are adds with fixed spawn spots, not 'under a random player' as in the real fight. Claw Tentacles: four `killable` (non-`killFirst`) adds spawning at known corners; the Offtank picks up the two on the west side by proximity (the research has tanks take the Claws that spawn near them) and ghosts handle the east pair, and a separate `hazard` (`groundRupture`, 1,350) marks 'under a random player' for the knockback the real Claw brings. Claws never Hamstring or melee; only one Offtank role plays. Eye Tentacles: 8 in a ring on BW/DBM timers (45 s P1, then one wave per Phase 2 surface), `killFirst`, `lifetime` 12, a placeholder for how fast the raid burns them; Mind Flay cannot be tied to the tentacles' being alive (`adds` cannot act), so it is a separate `debuff` on the raid at spawn. Giant Claw and Giant Eye Tentacles: `adds`; the giant claw must be picked up by a tank; the giant eye is `killFirst`; Thrash, Ground Tremor and the Giant Eye's Eye Beam are simplified to the same carried-bomb Eye Beam, with `conditional: debuff:gEyeUp`. Digestive Acid is a stacking `debuff` (`tickDamage` 35 per stack, 12 stacks) during the stomach phase. `whelpsOnRaid` is informational here: the engine also counts tentacles a ghost group holds, and the formation puts a raider near every spawn. The stomach is `bossState: submerged` for 25 s: melee, ranged and healers walk to two Flesh Tentacle islands in the middle of the same room and kill them (`killFirst`, 18 s `lifetime`), and tanks leave at once and wait on the surface, as Wowhead and Warcraft Tavern say (they are off the acid's `roles` for the same reason); no one is Devoured one by one, no acid pool exit exists, and the 'leave by 10 stacks' rule is shown by a rising acid debuff and the phase timer. Real Devour (one player every ~10 s) and the Stomach team's exit are not modelled, so a healer or ranged role playing C'Thun practises the surface and the kills but not being eaten. Weakened: the 45 s window has no spawns and is the only time the ghost raid is meant to hit C'Thun. The Carapace is a `bossOnly` `shield` (`carapace`, `carapace2`, 99% reduction in the real fight) that runs for each surface phase: tentacles are still hit and the DPS target while it holds, and any attack on C'Thun meanwhile counts as `attacksIntoShield`. HP still moves by phase, so the reduction is a scored behaviour and not real damage. Tentacle HP gaps stand as `cthun.md` lists them ('Seasonal 40 Player' values).

tank.label: Main tank
tank.description: No boss to tank in Phase 1: stand on your spot and stay out of Dark Glare. In Phase 2 you catch every Giant Claw Tentacle the second it surfaces.

melee.label: Melee DPS
melee.description: Tentacles first, then the boss. Eye Tentacles, then Claws, then the Eye. In the stomach kill the Flesh Tentacles. Hold your ten-yard spacing; if a beam lands on you, step away only if someone is inside the circle.

ranged.label: Ranged DPS
ranged.description: Stay on your spot, ten yards from everyone. Eye Tentacles die first. Hold your ten-yard spacing; if a beam lands on you, step away only if someone is inside the circle. Rotate with the Dark Glare.

healer.label: Healer
healer.description: Heal the raid through the Eye Beams and Mind Flay. Hold your ten-yard spacing; if a beam lands on you, step away only if someone is inside the circle.

taunt.label: Taunt
taunt.tip: Used only to pick up tentacles.

attack.tip: Attacks generate threat. Stop when the threat bar turns red so the boss stays on the tank.
